harbor.layout: cases x rows(south->north) x cols(west->east); ratio = Hs/Hs0*100; dir = deg*256/360 (from)

lane.layout: cases x rows(south->north) x cols(west->east); ratio = Hs/Hs0*100; dir = deg*256/360 (from)

trail.layout: cases x rows(south->north) x cols(west->east); ratio = Hs/Hs0*100; dir = deg*256/360 (from)
